_comment: Hand-picked POIs and hand-removed ones. 'exclude' drops a stop by name, per day, after somebody has looked at it - OSM tagging cannot tell you whether a place is worth stopping at. Everything else here is added verbatim and never thinned. Re-run scripts/add_services.py then scripts/prepare_gpx.py to apply changes. type must be one of Water, Toilets, Food, Store, Winery, Picnic, Scenic, Historic.

2.name: Steamer Lane Supply
2.note: 698 West Cliff Dr, Santa Cruz, above Steamer Lane. Coffee and breakfast burritos; opens 08:00. A detour west out of town, not a stop on the line south.

2.name: Stagnaro Bros. Seafood
2.note: Santa Cruz Wharf. Clam chowder and fresh seafood. A detour out onto the wharf, not a stop on the line south.

2.name: Captain + Stoker
2.note: 398 E Franklin St, Monterey. Coffee and pastries; opens 6:30 weekdays, 7:30 weekends.

5.name: Tres Hermanos Coffee
5.note: 315 S Main St, Templeton. Chosen by hand; the pin is OpenStreetMap's 315 Main Street address point.

6.name: Foxen Winery
6.note: Foxen Canyon Road, right on the route. OpenStreetMap carries two Foxen tasting rooms 0.35 mi apart and names them only #1 and #2; this is the northern one.

6.name: El Rancho Market
6.note: 2886 Mission Dr, Solvang. Full grocery with a deli counter - the last proper resupply before Solvang. Sits 1.2 mi off the line.

6.name: Old Mission Santa Ines
6.note: Solvang, where the day ends. Founded 1804; church and museum open to visitors.

6.name: Bridlewood Winery
6.note: 3555 Roblar Ave, Santa Ynez. Chosen by hand. The pin is Roblar Avenue itself, not the driveway - OpenStreetMap has no address point for 3555 - so navigate by name rather than by the dot.

7.name: Boathouse at Hendry's Beach
7.note: 2981 Cliff Dr, Santa Barbara, on Arroyo Burro beach. Open 7:30.

7.name: Chad's Cafe
7.note: 216 W Cabrillo Blvd, Santa Barbara, across from the beach. Breakfast until 14:30.

7.name: Isla Vista Freebirds
7.note: 879 Embarcadero del Norte, Isla Vista. Burritos, open late, in the middle of the student blocks a short way off the line.

3.name: Trader Joe's
3.note: 570 Munras Avenue, Monterey. Right on the route at mi 3 - the last full grocery before the valley.

4.name: San Miguel Market & Deli
4.note: 1299 Mission St unit 5, San Miguel. Chosen by hand; the pin is the 1299 Mission Street block, taken from the nearest address point OpenStreetMap carries, so it is the block rather than the door.
